pick.headline: Former President Richard Nixon dies
pick.fbis: The Latin America Daily Report of April 25, 1994, carried Mexico City NOTIMEX: President Salinas sent condolences to Nixon's daughters, noting that Nixon, 81, died after a stroke and had stepped down over Watergate.
